name: Lancing Hiltfold
description: Draw both blades out of their folded rest against the forearms and cut as they open.

name: Facet Swingguard
description: Fold the blades against the forearms and take a blow on the backs of the steel.

name: Rumble Shearedge
description: Snap one folded blade straight outward so the point lands before the arm seems to move.

name: Whipping Scissor
description: Sink the weight and fold the body into a low pace that draws the opponent forward.

name: Blaze Fliptang
description: A qi pulse stored in the folded wrist is released as the blade opens in a hard snap.

name: Ponderous Doublehilt
description: Close the folded blades over the opposing sword and press until its owner cannot draw it free.

name: Shortedge Torment
description: Take a blow on the folded guard and open both blades at once in a qi-weighted double cut.

name: Lotwing
description: Hold the folded blades across the opponent's weapon arm while qi presses and numbs its strength for a breath.

name: Scuteassault
description: Draw the blades with the qi field already rolling along them so the first cut reaches a finger further.

name: Hoarfrost Wristside
description: Hold the guard so the field covers a palm's depth beyond the crossed blades.

name: Flurry Maelstrom
description: Jab with the lead blade and let the field extend the reach of the point beyond the steel.

name: Siltflurry
description: Drift forward on the cushion of the field so footfalls make no sound on stone.

name: Might Clipper
description: Send a pulse of the field out of the blade tip on the cut to nick a guard beyond the steel.

name: Hamstringing Crossing
description: Let the field lap round the opposing blade and tug it out of line as the guard hooks it.

name: Iron Platepoint
description: Spread the field like open wings from both blades to shield the ribs and the back.

name: Shearing Barrage
description: Close the blades with the field spread between them so the shear lands on a foe outside blade reach.

name: Downpour Snapcut
description: Spin once with both blades outstretched and sweep the field across every opponent standing close around you.

name: Annealed Cheekhilt
description: Stand with the two blades positioned so that each shadows the line the other leaves open.

name: Annealed Fliptang
description: One blade deflects and hands the blow over to the other which turns it away completely.

name: Steadfast Hiltfold
description: Trade the high and low guard positions between the blades in the instant of a feint.

name: Mightmoth
description: Advance while holding the full guard so each pace shortens the distance without exposing a line.

name: Piercing Scissor
description: Thrust with one blade while the other blade closes over the line the thrust has left behind.

name: Cheekhilt Plating
description: Qi runs between the blades and fills the thin gap in the guard like mortar between stones.

name: Furrowing Flurry
description: Without opening the guard slip a qi-backed cut through the single gap the foe has just made.

name: Torrent Shortedge
description: Give with a heavy blow by turning the body and let qi bleed its force into the floor.

name: Immovable Wristside
description: Hold a woven barrier of two blades and flowing qi that stops sustained blows and heavy thrusts together.

name: Gustscute
description: Let the guard part like a door at the last instant and cut through the lunging foe.

name: Gust Edgepair
description: Move toward the widest gap among the foes so no two can reach with weapons at once.

name: Manacling Clipper
description: Hook an enemy weapon with the guard and pull it into a second enemy's path.

name: Ironmoth
description: Turn on the lead foot and cut the nearest flanker across the forearm.

name: Torrent Swingguard
description: Deflect a thrust from behind by swinging one blade backward without turning the head.

name: Crossing Pounce
description: Weave through the press of bodies with the field thin and wary to feel each approaching blade.

name: Thorn Snapcut
description: Bind two reaching weapons together with the crossed blades so the owners fall into each other.

name: Siltpleat
description: Wheel in a full circle with qi-lengthened edges and cut every opponent whose guard is lowered.

name: Intentmoth
description: Cut thrust and shoulder your way through a rank of armed men in one forward surge.

name: Thornpleat
description: Stand with both blades mirrored across the centerline in the formal opening of the twin courts.

name: Raging Platepoint
description: Bow forward from the mirrored stance and cut with both edges leading in one graceful arc.

name: Rumble Edgepair
description: Thrust with both blades into the same hollow of the opponent's guard like water into a basin.

name: Unyielding Fliptang
description: Turn the near blade to deflect and the far blade to repeat the same motion in the opposite hand.

name: Shortedge Jaunt
description: Take two even paces forward in the formal tempo that always begins on the left foot.

name: Gust Hiltfold
description: Slide along the line of the opponent's attack the way a river bends past a stone.

name: Sanguine Shearedge
description: Cut with both blades along matching lines so the qi in each steadies the other.

name: Murkpleat
description: Fix the gaze on one shoulder as a hawk would while the unwatched blade strikes the other side.

name: Hoarfrost Shearing
description: Pair the blades around the opposing sword in a formal lock and hold it with steady qi.

name: Ravaging Gust Clipper
description: Both blades answer a single attack with matching qi-weighted cuts on either side of its line.

name: Verity Edgepair
description: Gather the force of repeated blows into the guard like rain into a basin then release it in one reply.

name: Wingbarrage
description: Draw the blades with the hooked guards forward like talons and rake the first line of the guard.

name: Aegis Cheekhilt
description: Hold the blades still and low like a perched hawk watching the opponent's shoulders for any twitch.

name: Tempered Doublehilt
description: Drop from a high guard and stab down at the throat in a steep fast stoop.

name: Soaring Wristside
description: Tilt the whole body to one side and slide past a thrust like a hawk banking on the wind.

name: Gyvepleat
description: Close the field around the opposing blade like talons and hold it fast against the guard.

name: Iron Shearedge
description: Rake both hooked guards and blades down the opponent's forearms in a field-wrapped cut.

name: Granite Doublehilt
description: Cross the distance in one qi-light step that seems to fall over the opponent like a shadow.

name: Lot Scissor
description: First the talons seize a weapon or arm then the free blade drives a qi-deep thrust into the body.

name: Driving Snapcut
description: Gather the field overhead then plunge both blades down on one point in a single violent stoop.

name: Thornscute
description: Stand with the blades curved in front like the lip of a basin ready to catch whatever falls.

name: Murk Swingguard
description: Bend the blade outward in a long curve that carries a blow around the body like a river bend.

name: Tempered Crossing
description: Both blades flow in the same direction across the target like two currents running together.

name: Silt Crossing
description: Turn out of the attack in a small eddy of the feet and let the blow roll past.

name: Needling Flurry
description: Let the opponent's rush settle and jab the exposed gap as a basin shows its floor.

name: Platepoint Plating
description: Gather qi into a pooled barrier between the blades that rises with each added blow.

name: Wingthrash
description: When the pooled guard is full release the stored force in a cut that overflows its rim.

name: Toxin Fliptang
description: Carry the opposing blade down the river line of the guard until the foe is off balance.

name: Equipoise Wristside
description: Pour a steady flood of qi along both blades to drown the force of incoming strikes.

name: Gustmoth
description: Gather a heavy blow in the basin guard and send it away down the river line to leave the foe stumbling.

name: Pleattorment
description: Draw from a settled seat in the stance and cut with the matched pair of edges.

name: Doublehilt Cuirass
description: Set the matched edges against a blow so the court's even guard takes it on both blades.

name: Facetflurry
description: Thrust in a formal line at chest height from the shortest distance of the court.

name: Shortedge Pounce
description: Close the distance in one measured step and not an inch more than the exchange needs.

name: Verityscute
description: Spread a calm field to learn the opponent's weight and reach before any blade is drawn.

name: Mayhemscute
description: Show a plain readable shoulder and let the cut come from the other hand unseen.

name: Gust Swingguard
description: Meet a cut with both edges together so the parry rings once and the foe's blade turns aside.

name: Raging Cheekhilt
description: Answer a parry with a qi-bright cut delivered in the formal measure of the court.

name: Hoarfrost Hiltfold
description: Hold an opponent's weapon between both edges in a lock that the court prizes as courteous.

name: Silt Shearing
description: Take the court's even pace backward and let the field steady the body for the next exchange.

name: Granite Clipper
description: Settle the whole exchange with one paired cut backed by the full weight of the field.

name: Intentwing
description: Hold both edges across the opponent's arms until the field seals their motion for a measured moment.

name: Skinning Platepoint
description: Draw and cut in the same light step so the blow arrives with the wind at its back.

name: Steadfast Edgepair
description: Flick the blades like a gust of wind across the line of a cut and send it away.

name: Raging Flurry
description: Take a bearing on the opponent's throat and jab along it before the step has settled.

name: Siltscute
description: Slip a pace in whatever direction the wind of the fight pushes the body.

name: Shearedge Assault
description: Step through with qi lifting the body and cut as the foot lands on the far side.

name: Mothplating
description: Turn across the line of attack like a crosswind and take the blow on a sloping blade.

name: Surging Shortedge
description: Two linked wind steps let both blades land on the foe's flank before the guard can turn.

name: Tiered Intent Swingguard
description: Rush forward on a gust of qi and chain cut and thrust until the oath's promised distance is closed.

name: Hoarfrost Cheekhilt
description: Stand square like a rim of the plateau with the blades set wide to meet any approach.

name: Wrecking Shearing
description: Cut across the open ground in a wide arc that gives the opponent no place to settle.

name: Chime Hiltfold
description: Parry in place without stepping back as an oath-sworn swordsman holds the ground he swore to.

name: Rumble Shearing
description: Thrust along the direction of the wind so that the point flies true and fast.

name: Mightpleat
description: Advance on a fixed bearing without veering whatever blows come from either flank.

name: Silencing Snapcut
description: Draw the blades across the opposing steel in a pulling wind that tears its line apart.

name: Facetwing
description: Spread the field flat and wide to shelter the swordsman from two or three sides at once.

name: Iron Doublehilt
description: Answer a blow on the sworn ground with a field-bright cut that follows the parry at once.

name: Granite Scissor
description: Turn on the spot in a ring of wind-swift cuts that clears the ground around the swordsman.

name: Aegis Edgepair
description: Hold the bearing against three attackers and answer the first to fall into reach with a decisive cut.

name: Resilient Platepoint
description: Plant the stance on a chosen bearing and let the blades answer from there without drifting.

name: Gustwing
description: Yield at the shoulder like grass bending in wind and let the cut slide away.

name: Drubbing Scissor
description: Jab from the side of the opponent's guard as a crosswind comes from the unguarded flank.

name: Fliptang Leap
description: Lean into the opponent's push and shift the feet only enough to stay on the bearing.

name: Chimescute
description: Read the direction of each blow through the guard and correct the bearing by a hair.

name: Immovable Shearedge
description: Shed repeated blows from the guard like gusts that pass the stone they cannot move.

name: Gyve Crossing
description: Wrap the crossed blades around the opposing sword in a gentle lock that grows tighter.

name: Drubbing Clipper
description: Let the bent guard spring back and send both edges across the opening in a qi-driven reply.

name: Wristside Greave
description: Hold the bearing against a heavy assault while qi dissolves the weight of each blow on the blades.

name: Might Crossing
description: Speak the oath silently on the draw and cut as the last word is finished.

name: Enduring Cheekhilt
description: Brace the pair of blades against a hard gale of blows and keep the feet planted.

name: Grinding Flurry
description: Thrust thin and fast like a needle of wind through a gap in the armor.

name: Siltmoth
description: Hop on the ball of the foot as a gust lifts a leaf and land inside the guard.

name: Rumble Scissor
description: Cut so swiftly that the sound of the blade arrives after the edge has passed.

name: Intent Shearedge
description: Breathe the sworn words in time with the blades and steady qi through both wrists.

name: Ironwing
description: Cross both blades through the foe's guard in a tearing cut that follows the wind's own line.

name: Gyve Hiltfold
description: Turn the opposing blade with a spiral of qi until the wind of the bind pulls it from the hand.

name: Alternating Platepoint
description: Rush on a gale of qi chaining four cuts and a thrust to the oath's closing word.

name: Sanguine Snapcut
description: Close both blades in a wind-sped shear that cuts the opposing arm and throws the weapon wide.
